exposure: Implementation of a structured treatment algorithm (TA) for lateral malleolar fractures (compared to treatment before TA implementation)
cohort: Two cohorts of patients with lateral malleolar fractures of type AO/OTA44-B1, one treated before the introduction of a treatment algorithm (n=410) and one treated after (n=333) at Sahlgrenska University Hospital.
finding: The introduction of a structured treatment algorithm that reduced primary surgical procedures for lateral malleolar ankle fractures led to a statistically significant reduction in the reoperation rate from 7.1% to 2.4% without an increase in reoperations due to non-union.
